description: What caused what in a run, as a list of edges. Each edge says which event produced which, and whether it is `recorded` — the recorder watched it happen and wrote it into the trace — or `inferred`, meaning this derived it just now from the rule it names and the trace does not vouch for it. Pass `to` to get only the chain that produced one event, which is the shape of an answer to "why did this fail" rather than "what happened".

run.description: Run id, or "last" for the newest recording. Defaults to "last". Replay traces are skipped when resolving "last", so it means the newest run you actually recorded.

to.description: Narrow to the chain that produced this event seq. Omit for the whole run.

name: orca_graph
